description: Substantially the same service descriptions appear in three places: services.md's per-service summaries, each service's own dedicated page in the same directory, and (for several services) the Capella tree's feature descriptions. The three are not identical, which is the problem - indexes.md and services.md already contradict each other on Analytics indexing (see server-who-creates-analytics-indexes-contradiction), and three-way duplication is how that happens. This is the fourth content-duplication issue logged across rounds (fts-index-management, fts-search-doc-overlap, storage-engine-split); at four occurrences it is a structural property of the doc set rather than four local mistakes.
